scope: Allocation-failure rollback across both vectors used to append a legacy MLEADER DXF group-330 block label.

implementation.behavior: The parser checks the label cap and retained-byte/vector size relationship, then reserves the required capacity in blockLabels and the paired retained-byte vector before resizing or publishing either entry. The handle value is consumed only after both reserves succeed.

control.allocationInjection: MaterialAllocationFailure offsets 0 and 1 target the blockLabels reserve and paired retained-byte reserve.
checks: Each injected failure occurs exactly once and leaves blockLabels empty.
After each failure, retry group 330 with handle A10B and group 302 with the label text; the paired parser state accepts and retains both fields.

limits: This covers only legacy MLEADER DXF group-330 label allocation and its paired retained-byte bookkeeping.
It does not qualify MLEADER physical producer breadth, native annotation semantics, DWG parsing, or complete document conversion.
next: Continue P6 safety review at a separate reproduced parser allocation or rollback boundary; keep native and whole-document qualification gates open.
